title: Townhome next to Gallatin Marina
description:
Beautiful new townhome on Old Hickory Lake next to the Gallatin Marina! This home comes fully stocked with essentials for your getaway! Featuring 3 bedrooms, 2.5 baths, living room with a pull out couch, loft with a bed and a screened-in porch with remote control screens for your ultimate outdoor enjoyment. Located just 30 mins from Nashville Airport! Make sure to check out all that Gallatin Marina has to offer, including; boat rentals, tiki cruises and Awedaddys Bar & Grill. (seasonal)

Other things to note
Please note- Security cameras are located outside at the front door and back door for security and safety of our guests.
